name: migrate_configs_v2
description: Rewrites v1 service config JSON files in a directory (default configs) in place to the v2 format (version, service{name,port}, boolean debug, hosts array, timeoutMs). Skips files already v2. Returns counts and per-file errors.
whenToUse: When migrating a directory of v1 service configs to v2; reusable in other environments.

provenance.reason: migrate 30 v1 configs to v2, needed again in other environments
